name: Final Automatic Malnutrition Early Warning Engine
current_month_logic: The system runtime calendar month is automatically used as the common forecast origin.
warning_trigger: Existing DMBI Priority_Level is HIGH or CRITICAL.
medium_logic: MEDIUM is watch only and does not trigger an active warning.
low_logic: LOW does not trigger a warning.
combined_notification_logic: One combined notification record is created per district. The record contains H1, H3 and H6 status. Overall_Severity is the highest severity among H1/H3/H6.
nearest_warning_logic: Nearest_Warning_Horizon is the smallest horizon among active HIGH/CRITICAL horizon warnings.
interpretation: Research-based operational planning early warning. Priority levels are not clinical emergency diagnoses.
